q1.sourceTranscript: Hey, I just wanted to tell you about my new car! It's a small one, perfect for my needs. I got it for a great price-only 3,250 pounds! Can you believe it? I was looking at bigger models too, but they were way more expensive, around 3,550 pounds or even 4,250 pounds. I'm really happy with my choice!
